performance.verdict: Lead_drought is a tracking gap, not a real zero — GHL shows 45 opps created.

findings.text: Lead tracking shows 0 leads across all 28 days, yet GHL recorded 45 opportunities created — confirming a broken lead-source attribution pipe, not a real drought.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and has no completed event recorded — 27 days overdue; speed-to-lead automation integrity is unverified.
GBP actions collapsed 68.75% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 24–26) recorded 8, 0, 0 actions vs prior 3 days (Aug 21–23) averaging 2.7 — 3-day signal confirms the drop is real and accelerating.
Google spend is erratic — 8 of 28 days recorded $0 spend, including Aug 22 and Aug 26 — suggesting campaign pacing or budget exhaustion mid-cycle rather than intentional throttle.
Intake ownership is unresolved since Vivian left 7/7; with 45 opps created and 0 appointments logged in GHL, leads may be arriving but stalling at dispatch — an intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Repair lead-source tracking so GHL opportunities flow into the leads metric; 45 opps exist but 0 register in reporting.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 45 opportunities created in the 28-day window, but the leads metric reads 0 across every channel — the source-tagging or webhook between Google Ads/GBP and GHL is broken. Audit the GHL lead-source webhook and Google Ads conversion import to confirm handoff is firing correctly. Success is confirmed when at least 1 Google Ads conversion maps to a GHL opportunity with a named source by 2026-08-30. Until this is fixed, CPL and spend efficiency cannot be evaluated.

suggestions.text: Complete booking bot battle-test (overdue 27 days) and confirm intake seat owner and GHL login post-Vivian departure.
suggestions.monday_update: The booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and remains unverified; simultaneously, 0 appointments are logged in GHL despite 45 opportunities created, pointing to a broken or unmanned intake queue since Vivian left on 7/7. Confirm who owns the GHL dispatch seat today, verify their login and after-hours coverage, then run the battle-test end-to-end. Success is a logged appointment in GHL within 5 minutes of a test inquiry submission — target completion by 2026-08-30.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions over next 3 days; if Aug 27–29 remain at 0, escalate to GBP audit for listing health or suspension risk.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 68.75% week-over-week and the last 3 days (Aug 24–26) recorded 8, 0, 0 — the 3-day signal is deteriorating. No budget action is warranted yet because the scale-back-up gate is still active and the cause is unconfirmed. Monitor Aug 27, 28, and 29 actions; if the zero pattern holds for all three days, escalate to a full GBP listing health audit by 2026-08-30 to rule out suspension or data lag.
